narrative.overview:
This records the implemented system, not a redesign. Inter, forest primary actions,
dark ink, and the existing book mark connect the surfaces. The dashboard uses cool
neutral working surfaces; landing and documentation use warm paper. The documentation
reader adds a **docs-only dark theme**.
dos: use the stylesheet and token source for the surface being changed.
preserve the existing book mark, self-hosted Inter, and source attribution.

keep screenshot provenance in [docs/screenshots/README.md](docs/screenshots/README.md);
  the reader reuses those synthetic captures unchanged.
donts: apply the docs-only dark palette or reader typography to dashboard or landing.
treat surface-specific dimensions, radii, or motion as universal tokens.
